get.description:
Store staff / delivery partner. **Draft → submit.** Every upload is saved as a `DRAFT` (`state: DRAFT`): preview it (`frontFile` / `backFile`, GET with your token), replace it (upload the same type again) or delete it. `POST …/submit` locks all drafts for review — needs the full set (`SELFIE` + one of `NID` / `PASSPORT` / `DRIVING_LICENSE`, riders on a motor vehicle also `DRIVING_LICENSE` + `VEHICLE_RC`).

**Replacing.** One live document per type: a new upload of a type replaces the old one while it isn't approved (draft, pending or rejected). An **approved** document is never removed by an upload — the new one waits next to it, and only an admin removes the old one (removal request).

**OTHER** = any extra document (several allowed, up to 10, `title` required). It never counts toward the required set.

**OTHER** = any extra document (several allowed, up to 10, `title` required). It never counts toward the required set.

- Media not KYC / not uploaded by you (KYC_MEDIA_INVALID)
- Media already used by another document (KYC_MEDIA_IN_USE)

- More than 10 OTHER documents (KYC_TOO_MANY_OTHER)

type.description: NID / PASSPORT / DRIVING_LICENSE prove identity; SELFIE; VEHICLE_RC (riders). OTHER = any extra document — several allowed, `title` required. Uploading a type you already have replaces it while it isn't approved; an approved one stays until an admin removes it.

documentNumber.description: NID (10 / 13 / 17 digits), passport or licence number. Stored masked (last 4 only)

note.example: Old NID photo is blurred, uploaded a new one

title.description: Per-language title. In multipart, send as JSON string, e.g. {"en":"Red apple","hi":"लाल सेब"}. Max length per language: config media.text.titleMaxLen

alt.description: Per-language alt text. Max length per language: config media.text.altMaxLen

status.description: URLs are null until READY (resizing takes a second or two after upload)

language.description: Default app / notification language (one of LANGUAGES)

settings.description: Merged into saved settings; send only what changes

file.description: JPEG / PNG / WebP. Cropped to a 512×512 square (200×200 thumbnail); must be at least that size.

nextSendInSec.description: Seconds until a resend is allowed
